## Shared interface: frozen pressure cases (tools/fixtures/mori-pressure/cases.json)
{"schema":"mori-pressure-cases-v1","cases":[{"id":"P01","topic":"...","args":[],"snapshots":[{"files":{"cpu":"<file text>","memory":"...","io":"...","irq":"..."},"errors":{"irq":"EOPNOTSUPP"}}],"expect":{"exit":0,"verdict":"PRESSURE_OK","resources":{"cpu":{"state":"ok","full_system_undefined":true},"irq":{"state":"ok","some":null}},"findings_include":[["PRESSURE_HIGH","memory"]]}}]}
- A file named neither in `files` nor in `errors` reads as ENOENT. `errors` values: EOPNOTSUPP, EACCES, EPERM.

- Output fields: top level `schema` ("mori-pressure-v1"), `root`, `resources`, `verdict`, `findings` (list of objects with at least `id` and `resource`). Each resource: `state` (ok | absent | unsupported | unreadable | malformed | counter_regressed), `some` and `full` (null or an object with avg10, avg60, avg300 as floats and total as int; with --interval also total_delta_us int and stall_ratio float rounded to 6 places), `notes` (list of strings); cpu also carries `full_system_undefined: true`.
- Matching: `exit` and `verdict` exact; each key under expect.resources.<r> must equal the output key, and an expected object under some/full matches as a subset of the output object; every [id, resource] pair in findings_include must appear in findings.
